content_sections.heading: NIT Goa Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for NIT Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the NIT Goa Recruitment 2026 is Faculty. This is a temporary position within the Mathematics department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Faculty post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Faculty post announced by NIT Goa in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Faculty position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class M.Sc. degree with a Ph.D. (awarded or thesis submitted) in Mathematics to be eligible for the Faculty position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Faculty role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 70,000/- per month for candidates with a PhD Degree, or Rs. 50,000/- per month for those with a PG Degree and PhD Thesis submitted.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIT Goa Faculty position?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report at the specified venue with all required documents on the interview date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the walk-in interview date and time?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should report by 09:00 AM, and registration closes at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the CV Raman Complex, National Institute of Technology Goa, Cuncolim - 403 703, Goa.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their ID proof, scanned copies of original documents, published papers (if any), and a duly filled application form.

faq.question: Q10. Will there be an online interview option?
faq.answer: No, the interview will be conducted in offline mode only. Online interviews will not be permitted.
